يتفلسف (form IIq)
# يَتَفَلْسَفُ (yatafalsafu) /ja.ta.fal.sa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
# يُتَفَلْسَفُ (yutafalsafu) /ju.ta.fal.sa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
# يَتَفَلْسَفَ (yatafalsafa) /ja.ta.fal.sa.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
